name: MM-BrowseComp
intro: MM-BrowseComp是一个全面的多模态深度研究基准，旨在评估智能体通过浏览和推理多模态网页内容来解决复杂问题的能力。该基准包含224个具有挑战性的多跳问题，每个问题的解决方案都特意设计为需要理解图像或视频模态中的内容。评估结果显示，即使是OpenAI o3等最强模型也未能超过30%的准确率，凸显了当前模型在多模态理解和推理方面的不足。该基准还提供了经过验证的清单，用于细粒度分析多模态依赖性和推理路径。
org: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Tsinghua University, University of California, B
build_method: 专家构建, 人工标注
modality: 文本, 图像, 视频, 多模态
eval_feature: 动态更新, 防污染, 过程评估
intro_en: MM-BrowseComp is a comprehensive multimodal deep research benchmark designed to evaluate agents' ability to solve complex problems by browsing and reasoning over multimodal web content. The benchmark includes 224 challenging multi-hop questions, each requiring understanding of content in image or video modalities. Evaluation results show that even top models like OpenAI o3 fail to exceed 30% accuracy, highlighting current limitations in multimodal understanding and reasoning. The benchmark also provides a validated checklist for fine-grained analysis of multimodal dependencies and reasoning paths.

flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Start from deep-research browsing scenarios where text-only search is insufficient"] --> B["Hand-craft 224 challenging questions for multimodal web retrieval and reasoning"]
    B --> C["Require key evidence to appear in image or video content from web pages or prompts"]
    C --> D["Design questions as multi-hop problems that cannot be solved by text-only shortcuts"]
    D --> E["Attach a verified checklist that records the minimal reasoning path for each item"]
    E --> F["Release encrypted question-answer data with a canary string for contamination control"]
    F --> G["Evaluate tool-using browsing agents that search, inspect multimodal content, and answer"]
    G --> H["Report exact-match style accuracy and analyze multimodal dependency failures"]

    B --> C["要求关键证据来自网页或题面中的图像/视频内容"]

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2508.13186 and the MM-BrowseComp repository. The benchmark contains 224 hand-crafted multi-hop questions for multimodal browsing agents; solutions intentionally require understanding image or video content, each item has a verified checklist for the irreducible reasoning path, the repo uses encrypted data plus a canary string, and evaluation reports accuracy for browsing agents.
